summary:
YOU - How do I make him trust me?
EMPATHY - Do your job first. Then make him feel like no one on this earth ever has.
Harry du Bois, a man without memory, awakens in a strange hostel room. Over the course of the investigation in Martinaise, he becomes inexplicably obsessed with a certain colleague from the 57th Precinct to the point of complete and total worship. He is, after all, a stray, and Kim is a lonely man with a home big enough for a dog.
